component.name: MnSymbol font
component.summary: Mathematical symbol font for Adobe MinionPro

description.p: MnSymbol is a symbol font family, designed to be used in conjunction with Adobe Minion Pro. Almost all of LATEX and AMS mathematical symbols are provided. The fonts are available both as METAFONT source and as Adobe Type 1 format, and a comprehensive support package is provided. While the fonts were designed to fit with Minion Pro, the design should fit well with other renaissance or baroque faces: indeed, it will probably work with most fonts that are neither too wide nor too thin, for example Palatino or Times; it is known to look good with Sabon.
